html:
Discover the timeless charm of Duong Lam Ancient Village with Vietlook Travel. Located just 50 km from Hanoi, this peaceful heritage village offers an immersive journey into Vietnam’s traditional countryside life. Wander through red-brick lanes, admire ancient laterite houses, learn about local culture, and enjoy authentic rural cuisine prepared by local families.

Highlights Of The Tour

  • Visit traditional houses that are over 400 years old and learn about their unique laterite architecture.

  • Explore Mia Pagoda and several historic communal temples that reflect Vietnam’s spiritual life.

  • Experience daily farming activities or take a leisurely bike ride through picturesque rice fields.

  • Enjoy a countryside lunch prepared with fresh, local ingredients at a family home in the village.

Who This Tour Is Perfect For

This private day trip is ideal for travelers who appreciate culture, photography, history, and authentic local experiences. Families, couples, and small groups will especially enjoy the peaceful atmosphere and hands-on activities.

What’s Included

  • Private car with driver

  • English-speaking local guide

  • Lunch at Duong Lam Ancient Village

  • All entrance fees

Tour Price

55 USD per person

Let Vietlook Travel design a memorable journey for you to Duong Lam Ancient Village. This experience can be arranged as a half-day trip, full-day adventure, or combined with other cultural destinations for a multi-day itinerary.
